post.title: Tree Data Structure Explained: Concepts, Implementation, and Interview Guide
post.subtitle: Trees are everywhere. From the DOM in your browser to the file system on your laptop. We explain Binary Trees, BSTs, and Heaps.
post.brief: Trees are hierarchical data structures used everywhere — file systems, HTML DOM, databases, and search algorithms. Understanding Binary Trees, BSTs, and Heaps gives you efficient $O(\log N)$ search, insertion, and deletion — and helps you ace a large class of interview problems.
